# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We aim to support the latest released version of modular-cli-menu.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you believe you found a security issue, do not open a public issue.

Please contact the repository owner privately and include:

- a short description of the issue
- affected version(s)
- reproduction steps
- any relevant logs, snippets, or proof of concept

We will review reports as soon as possible and coordinate a fix or mitigation.
